issues.where: bottom left, center, and right foreground bank
issues.what: The incoming whitewater stream is gone. The descending, gravelly bank has become a flat gray shelf behind a pile of oversized, faceted rocks.
issues.fix: Restore the stream flowing between the left-hand boulders into the lake, a continuous slope of graded scree, and smaller, more irregular near rocks.

issues.where: lake from the center pool to the orange margins
issues.what: The navy pool has a hard-edged, distorted reflection, and the surrounding rust-colored growth reads as broad smooth paint and stretched streaks rather than a fine branching mat in shallow water.
issues.fix: Calm the center into a dark blue mirror with localized rings, and break the margins into finer branching ochre strands, seams, and transparent shallows.

issues.where: bottom and lower middle of frame
issues.what: A nearly full-width band of dry-looking cobbles takes up the lower third, where the target looks across flooded shallows with a rocky lip chiefly at lower left.
issues.fix: Keep the animals at the intended distance, but drop or shift the camera to the waterline and open the center and right to continuous shallow water.

issues.where: shallow water under and around the herd and the open lake behind it
issues.what: The water is dominated by uniform horizontal silver-brown chop. Much of the branching orange growth and the quiet cool-blue water beyond it are gone.
issues.fix: Restore broken amber mats and dark blue open water, quiet the general chop, and let clearly defined circular ripples spread outward from individual drinking points.

issues.where: middle and right of the lake beneath the far shore
issues.what: Gold-gray reflections and thin horizontal bars run nearly all the way to the shore, flattening the dark navy band and the gently rippled depth behind the amber shallows.
issues.fix: Bring back a coherent blue-black stretch beyond the shallows, with darker cliff reflections and fewer, softer, wider-spaced wave highlights.

issues.where: center and right foreground rocks, including the native-size crops
issues.what: Faceted seams, stretched mottling, and flat exposed ground replace granular gravel, fractured stone, and small mossy crevices.
issues.fix: Use natural irregular fracture planes, continuous rock texture at scale, dense embedded gravel, and small patches of growth in the crevices.

issues.what: The animals read as a dark rusty row along the shelf, mostly standing, with a few walkers out across the orange shallows. The target has pale side-lit animals scattered along the diagonal bank, with waders, drinkers, and several resting on the scree.
issues.fix: Break up the row along the sloping shore, restore the resting and drinking groups, and give the bodies warm left-side edges, readable cool fill, and small water-contact ripples where appropriate.

issues.where: right rim, overhang and far shore mist
issues.what: The near right rim is lower and less enclosing, with harder, more uniformly striated rock. The mist reads as a nearly level narrow stripe rather than a soft veil spreading out over the water.
issues.fix: Raise and deepen the nearest overhang, vary the strata and scree at its base, and feather the mist into the water and cliff foot at uneven densities.

issues.what: The wall is sharply etched nearly everywhere, with a strong orange cast over the left slopes and haze mostly pinned to the base; the target reads softer and deeper, with more selective yellow-gold light on ledges and cool recesses.
issues.fix: Soften distant texture and the haze transition while localizing warm illumination to the exposed upper faces and retaining cool blue-gray shadow.

issues.where: herd bodies and reflections at their feet
issues.what: Beyond the intended setback and animal design, the lighting is flatter brown, with muddy black ends and heavy smeared reflections instead of small warm grazing highlights and wet contact details.
issues.fix: Keep their distance and silhouettes, but add restrained warm edges where the low light catches wet surfaces, and finer broken reflections and foot-level disturbances.

issues.where: lower left through lower right underwater growth and rock
issues.what: The filaments read as a relatively uniform thin orange tangle under a milky reflection, with pale bedrock reduced to flat patches. The target has separate gold, rust, and olive bunches with directional drape and dimensional rocky gaps.
issues.fix: Build thicker, distinct bundles of long strands that wrap around credible submerged rock, vary the colored density, and clear some of the reflected veil to reveal the depth underneath.

issues.where: foreground water above the center-left and center-right mats
issues.what: Several vertical trails of bright bubbles visible over the growth in the target are missing.
issues.fix: Add sparse staggered bubble trails with tiny sunlit edges rising through the shallows, letting their motion soften naturally.

issues.where: far lake edge and crater wall
issues.what: The air has become a thin pale line under an unusually crisp, busy wall, rather than a broad soft bank of vapor that obscures the base and separates the warm upper ledges from the cooler lake.
issues.fix: Give the vapor more height and uneven density, soften the distant rock texture, and keep the warm rim light distinct from the cool lower shadows.

issues.where: left group and the water immediately at the drinker
issues.what: One of the two companions is upright rather than drinking, and the entry point of the main drinker is lost among regular horizontal ripple bands.
issues.fix: Keep the intended distance and silhouette, but give the companions low drinking poses and a restrained set of rings centered at the main animal’s muzzle.
